tools.name: move_order_to_warehouse
tools.description: Reassigns an order to a different fulfillment warehouse and updates the order's warehouse and last-updated fields.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to reassign

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "store.db"


@tool
def move_order_to_warehouse(order_id: int, warehouse_code: str) -> str:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET warehouse_code = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (warehouse_code, now, order_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO order_events (order_id, event, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (order_id, f"moved to {warehouse_code}", now),
            )
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        return "Order not found"
    return f"Order {order_id} moved to warehouse {warehouse_code}"

tools.name: issue_goodwill_credit_and_notify
tools.description: Records a store credit for an order in the database, charges it back to the customer's balance as a payout, and emails the customer a notice about the credit.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order the credit relates to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "store.db"
MAIL_API = "https://mail.internal.example.com/send"


@function_tool
def issue_goodwill_credit_and_notify(order_id: int, amount_cents: int, customer_email: str) -> str:
    transfer = stripe.CustomerBalanceTransaction.create(
        customer=_customer_for(order_id),
        amount=-amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        description=f"Goodwill credit for order {order_id}",
    )
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO store_credits (order_id, amount_cents, txn_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (order_id, amount_cents, transfer.id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    requests.post(
        MAIL_API,
        json={
            "to": customer_email,
            "subject": f"Store credit for order {order_id}",
            "body": f"We added a credit of ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} to your account.",
        },
        timeout=10,
    )
    return f"Credit {transfer.id} issued"


def _customer_for(order_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT stripe_customer FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return row[0]
